profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer at Digital Trusted Identity Services (DTIS)
profile.summary:
A graduate of the University of Wisconsin - Green Bay with a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science,  I developed software at Acuity Insurance from 2013 to 2019 before assuming a role at Digital Trusted Identity Services as a Senior Software Engineer. In 2021, I took over as leader of the FBI / FDLE channeling team at DTIS.

In that time, I've advanced from an entry level programmer to my current role as a Senior Engineer while designing and implementing full-stack solutions related to insurance and identity services.
